questions.question: Which wetland has been declared Chhattisgarh’s first Ramsar Site, marking a major environmental milestone for the state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kopra Reservoir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Kopra Reservoir in Bilaspur district has been declared Chhattisgarh’s first Ramsar Site under the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Kopra Reservoir is a freshwater wetland shaped by both natural processes and human-made structures.**
 
• **The reservoir is primarily rain-fed and supported by small seasonal streams.**
 
• **It functions as a vital water body in a semi-rural landscape, supporting livelihoods and ecological balance.**
 
• **Its hydrological and ecological significance qualified it for Ramsar recognition.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Ramsar Convention on Wetlands__

 __
 
• An international treaty for the conservation and sustainable use of wetlands.
 
• Recognises wetlands of international importance, especially as habitats for biodiversity.
 
• Encourages wise use of wetlands through national action and international cooperation.
 
 
 
• Ecological Importance of Kopra Reservoir__
 __
 
• Acts as an ecological hotspot supporting regional biodiversity.
 
• Enhances environmental resilience in the Bilaspur region.
 
• Plays a role beyond water storage, contributing to ecosystem stability.
 
 
 
• Significance for Chhattisgarh__
 
 
• First Ramsar-listed wetland for the state.
 
• Strengthens Chhattisgarh’s presence in national and global wetland conservation efforts.
 
• Highlights the importance of semi-rural freshwater ecosystems.

questions.question: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) was introduced primarily as part of:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Overhauling colonial-era criminal laws**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (**BNS**) aims to **replace colonial-era criminal laws**, specifically the Indian Penal Code (IPC), Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC), and the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.
 
• Introduced in **2023**, the BNS seeks to modernize and adapt laws to India's contemporary socio-political and cultural realities.
 
• The colonial-era IPC, drafted in **1860**, has been criticized for being outdated and unreflective of modern principles of justice and fairness.
 
• The overhaul under BNS aims to simplify legal procedures, ensure faster delivery of justice, and **decriminalize minor offenses** to reduce the burden on courts.
 
• The BNS emphasizes a victim-centric approach, enhancing provisions for victim compensation and rights within the legal framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Colonial-era criminal laws:**

 
 
• The **Indian Penal Code (IPC)**, enacted in **1860**, served as the backbone of criminal law in India, but its provisions reflect colonial priorities rather than modern Indian realities.
 
• The **Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC)**, implemented in **1973**, governs procedural aspects of criminal law but requires modernization to adapt to modern advancements.
 
• The **Indian Evidence Act**, passed in **1872**, outlines rules regarding evidence in trials, but some provisions are considered restrictive and outdated.
 
 
 
• **Key Features of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita:**
 
 
• **Modernization:** The BNS seeks to align criminal laws with the **Constitution of India** and contemporary legal practices.
 
• **Victim-Centric Approach:** It emphasizes **victim compensation** and ensures their rights are adequately protected during legal proceedings.
 
• **Decriminalization:** Minor offenses are being decriminalized to reduce the burden on the judicial system.
 
• **Transparency:** The laws promote transparent legal processes to ensure fairness and justice.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Options:**
 
 
• **Reforming Family Laws:** This relates to personal laws such as marriage, divorce, inheritance, and adoption, but is unrelated to the BNS.
 
• **Implementing Tax Reforms:** Tax reforms focus on financial policies like GST, corporate tax, etc., and are not connected to criminal law.
 
• **Expanding International Trade Laws:** This pertains to global commerce and trade agreements, which are entirely distinct from the scope of the BNS.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita was introduced to **replace outdated colonial laws** that no longer align with the modern principles of justice.
 
• It aims to ensure **speedy justice** by simplifying legal procedures and focusing on victim rights.
 
• The BNS aligns criminal laws with the **Indian Constitution** and modern values, ensuring that they reflect **India's current socio-political realities**.

questions.question: What is the official title of the Insurance Amendment Bill, 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Bill.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Bill, 2025 was passed by the Parliament of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Allows 100% Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in the insurance sector.**
 
• **Mandates accurate and verified policyholder records.**
 
• **Introduces right to data accuracy, privacy protection, and limits on data sharing.**
 
• **Promotes transparency in claim rejections, digital insurance policies, and stricter penalties for rule violations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Insurance Amendment Bill 2025** – Legislative reform to modernize India’s insurance sector.
 
• **100% FDI** – Permits full foreign investment in insurance companies to attract global capital.
 
• **Policyholder Data Accuracy & Privacy** – Ensures reliable records, security, and limited data sharing.
 
• **Digital Insurance Push** – Encourages technology-driven insurance processes and stricter regulatory compliance.

questions.question: Which of the following organisations in India developed the world’s highest-resolution weather forecasting model in May 2025?

options.text: National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting (NCMRWF)

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology (IITM)**, located in **Pune, Maharashtra**, is a premier research institute dedicated to studying and understanding tropical meteorology and weather-related phenomena.
 
• In **May 2025**, IITM developed the **world’s highest-resolution weather forecasting model**, showcasing its advanced capabilities in meteorological research and technology.
 
• This model provides **precise weather predictions**, aiding in disaster management, agriculture planning, and other critical sectors.
 
• IITM operates under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**, Government of India, emphasizing its importance in national-level weather forecasting and research initiatives.
 
• The institute is also known for its work on **monsoon studies**, climate change research, and development of models for understanding atmospheric dynamics.
 
• IITM has played a crucial role in establishing **state-of-the-art computing facilities** for weather prediction and climate modeling.
 
• Collaborating with international organizations and institutes, IITM contributes to global meteorological advancements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting (NCMRWF)**__

 __
 
• The **NCMRWF** is a scientific organization under the **Ministry of Earth Sciences**, Government of India.
 
• It specializes in **medium-range weather forecasting** using numerical models and data assimilation techniques.
 
• NCMRWF contributes to improving the accuracy of weather predictions over a span of 3 to 10 days.
 
 
 
• **India Meteorological Department (IMD)**__
 __
 
• The **IMD** is India’s national meteorological service, established in **1875**.
 
• It provides weather forecasts, warnings, and climate data for the country.
 
• IMD is responsible for monitoring cyclones, tsunamis, and other extreme weather events.
 
 
 
• **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**__
 
 
• **ISRO** is India’s space agency, known for its advancements in satellite technology and space exploration.
 
• It plays a significant role in **space-based weather monitoring** through satellites such as INSAT and GSAT series.
 
• Though not directly involved in developing weather models, ISRO supports meteorological studies via satellite data.

questions.question: What is the aim of the IndiaAI Face Authentication Challenge launched by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology?

options.text: To develop a facial authentication system for public exams
To enhance digital governance in India
To create a platform for startup innovations in AI

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To develop a facial authentication system for public exams.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **IndiaAI Face Authentication Challenge** aims to develop a facial authentication system for fair public exams and reduce fraudulent applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__

questions.question: Which organisation jointly developed the AI-based freight wagon monitoring system ‘DRISHTI’ along with the Northeast Frontier Railway?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Guwahati – TIDF.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian Railways is introducing the AI-based ‘DRISHTI’ Locking Monitoring System to detect tampered or unlocked freight wagon doors in real time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘DRISHTI’ is an AI-powered real-time surveillance system for monitoring door-lock conditions in freight wagons.
 
• Developed through a joint initiative between Northeast Frontier Railway and IIT Guwahati – TIDF.
 
• Enhances freight security by detecting tampering while the train is in motion.
 
• Supports Indian Railways' goal of modernising freight monitoring with advanced technology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR)**__

 __
 
• One of Indian Railways’ 19 zones, headquartered in Maligaon, Guwahati.
 
• Known for innovation in railway safety and technology adoption.
 
• Collaborated with IIT Guwahati on the DRISHTI project.
 
 
 
• **IIT Guwahati – TIDF**__
 __
 
• Technology Innovation and Development Foundation of IIT Guwahati.
 
• Focuses on AI, surveillance, and industrial automation solutions.
 
• Co-developer of the DRISHTI monitoring system.
 
 
 
• **AI-Based Monitoring in Railways**__
 __
 
• Improves real-time surveillance during train movement.
 
• Helps prevent theft, tampering, and operational risks.
 
• Part of India’s broader digital and smart-freight modernisation push.
 
 
 
• **DRISHTI System Features**__
 
 
• Monitors door lock conditions continuously.
 
• Alerts railway operators instantly on detecting anomalies.
 
• Enhances cargo safety and reduces freight losses.

questions.question: Which language recently received "Classical Language" status at the national level?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Marathi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Marathi** was recently granted the status of a **"Classical Language"** at the national level in India.
 
• A language is designated as a **Classical Language** when it meets certain criteria such as being of great antiquity, having a rich literary tradition, and being distinct from modern languages.
 
• The recognition as a Classical Language brings several benefits, including **financial assistance** for the development of the language and its literature.
 
• **Marathi** is an Indo-Aryan language spoken predominantly in the Indian state of **Maharashtra**.
 
• It is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India as per the **Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• The language has a long and rich history, with written records dating back to around the **11th century**.
 
• Marathi literature is known for its **diverse forms of poetry, prose, and drama**.
 
• The recognition is expected to further encourage the preservation, study, and promotion of **Marathi culture and heritage**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maithili**__

 __
 
• **Maithili** is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India as per the **Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution**.
 
• It is primarily spoken in the Indian state of **Bihar** and in parts of **Nepal**.
 
• Maithili has a long literary history with significant contributions in **poetry and folklore**.
 
 
 
• **Awadhi**__
 __
 
• **Awadhi** is a dialect of the **Eastern Hindi** language group.
 
• It is primarily spoken in the region of **Awadh** in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• Awadhi has a rich tradition in literature, including works like the **Ramcharitmanas by Tulsidas**.
 
 
 
• **Braj**__
 
 
• **Braj** is another dialect of the **Western Hindi** language group.
 
• It is spoken mainly in the region of **Braj Bhoomi**, which includes parts of Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan.
 
• Braj is known for its association with **Lord Krishna** and its contributions to **Bhakti literature**.
